content.title: The Crypto Prediction Divergence: When Accuracy Doesn't Equal Profit
content.abstract: This research explores the economic potential of integrating machine learning with technical analysis by analyzing major cryptocurrencies—Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Ripple -using long-term historical data from 2018 to 2024. While earlier studies have predominantly focused on short-term forecasts utilizing standard technical indicators, the broader performance of machine learning-assisted technical strategies across varying timeframes and market conditions remains underexplored. To bridge this research gap, XGBoost classification models are employed with a notably large feature set of 771
